proposed_decisions: Symbol \mathrel{|\!\sim}_\kappa is a subscripted variant of the existing ranked-consequence glyph \mathrel{|\!\sim} in symbols-intake-p15-rationality-5-3.csv; propose same family, scope thm:p15-w02b-p15-039-rational-monotony.
Cell-rank letters a,b,c,d are local to sec:p15-w02b-p15-039-reasons and do not collide with the update parameters a,b of def:p15-rat53-soft-update only by scope; registered with that scope.
\mathcal B_0(\lambda), M_0(\lambda) are argument forms of the existing B_z, M_z (symbols-intake-p15-rationality-5-3.csv); propose same family, scope sec:p15-w02b-p15-039-levi-harper.
\mathcal K+E reuses the expansion operator K+A of def:p08-agm in set form; propose no new registry glyph, note only.
lambda is used both as an arbitrary regular ranking (thm levi-harper) and as example rankings lambda_1, lambda_2 (thm consonant); scopes are disjoint theorem labels.
x,y name the new cell ranks of the two-cell update inside sec:p15-w02b-p15-039-independence (a,b in def:p15-rat53-soft-update) to avoid collision with cell ranks a,b,c,d.
